about_the_game:
⚠️ This game is only available in Japanese.
There is currently no English translation.

~ On the night of the full moon, the detectives face the phantom thief ~

One day, Alf, a boy helping out at his family’s restaurant,
is visited by his childhood friend — the young detective Sharlotte.

Alf: “Oh, Sharlotte, I didn’t see you come in. Ready to order?”
Sharlotte: “Hehehe... I was just waiting for you to be free! My order is... a brilliant assistant!”

The mysterious phantom thief “Oblutale” continues to elude capture,
leaving the entire kingdom buzzing with rumors and excitement.
To chase his trail, the two set out on a new adventure beneath the moonlight.

🔍 About the Game

Detective Looks at the Moon is a detective RPG
where you follow the story, gather clues, and solve mysteries to uncover the truth behind each case.
It features puzzles, reasoning, battles, skill learning, and side quests —
a variety of ways to enjoy the journey.

🧩 Game Features

■ In the main story, collect “clues” to uncover the mysteries hidden behind each incident.
■ Solve ciphers and puzzles to reveal secret bosses, and level up by defeating them.
■ Take on side quests to help townspeople and earn powerful items.
■ Let Sharlotte taste new dishes to inspire skills that aid her in battle — a unique growth system!
■ Strategic turn-based battles where elemental affinity and equipment choices are the key to victory.
■ Guilds, requests, cooking, and powerful bosses — aim for the highest Detective Rank!

💬 Developer’s Note

This game began as a hobby project,
but over the course of five years, it has been carefully crafted with love and detail.
I truly hope you enjoy the world and mysteries within.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 10 compatible GPU
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: On the night of the full moon, a young man becomes assistant to his childhood friend, a detective. They take on guild quests, solve mysteries, and chase the phantom thief “Obrutale,” a figure both feared and admired. A mystery RPG full of story, battles, and secrets.
